Contract ManageBankCardCRUDService::modifyBankCard(cardid: Integer,cardstatus: CardStatus[NORMAL|SUSPEND|CANCEL],catalog: CardCatalog[CREDIT|DEPOSIT],password: Integer,balance: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		bankCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(bankCard|bankCard.CardID = cardid)
	precondition:
		cardid>0
	postcondition:
		bankCard.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		bankCard.CardStatus = cardstatus and
		bankCard.Catalog = catalog and
		bankCard.Password = password and
		bankCard.Balance = balance and
		result = true or
		bankCard.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false
}
